basics.name: ARAVIND A
basics.headline: Full Stack ( MERN / PERN ) Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack MERN / PERN Developer (1.6 yrs) who ships production SaaS end-to-end auth systems (JWT/OAuth), payment webhooks, REST APIs, and cloud deployments.

highlights: Built 20+ production React modules (Redux Toolkit) for an internal ERP serving 500+ employees cut page load time 25% via render optimization and state restructuring.
Engineered a reusable React component library adopted by 3 teams, cutting duplicate code ~30% and feature delivery time by 2–3 days per sprint.
Debugged and stabilized business-critical JavaScript modules fixed scope-leakage and event-handling defects impacting 500+ daily users.
Integrated REST APIs across ERP modules and optimized SQL queries behind high-traffic reports cut month-end report generation time.
Drove sprint planning and peer code reviews enforced standards keeping production at zero critical bugs post-deployment.

projects.name: Arkalyn-Kitty — Group Expense Manager SaaS
projects.description: Built payment infrastructure with Razorpay HMAC webhook verification and idempotent locks handles concurrent financial operations without race conditions or double-charges.

projects.name: WorkZone - Task Management SaaS
projects.description: Implemented JWT auth with HttpOnly cookies and rotating refresh tokens (reuse detection) mitigates XSS token theft; supports 3 concurrent devices with per-device logout.
